name: Lyo.Payments
tagline: Payment collector contracts plus an internal workbench implementation (no Stripe).
description: `IPaymentCollector` collects funds and returns a reference. Hosts call Billing `RecordPaymentAsync` on success so the ledger is posted there. `InternalPaymentCollector` always succeeds and is meant for TestGateway / local workbenches.
features: No Stripe, card network, or plugin PDF references.

examples.title: Collect then record
